question: Which of the following is an example of constitutional bodies in India
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Election Commission of India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Election Commission of India** is a constitutional body established under Article 324 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It is responsible for administering elections to the **Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, and State Legislative Assemblies**, as well as the offices of the **President and Vice President** in India.
 
• The Election Commission operates independently of the government to ensure free and fair elections.
 
• **Election Commission of India**
 
 
• Establishment year - **1950**
 
• HQ - **New Delhi**
 
• Current Chief Election Commissioner - **Rajiv Kumar**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Human Rights Commission (NHRC)**

 
 
• Established in - **1993**
 
• HQ - **New Delhi**
 
• It is a statutory body constituted under the **Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993**.
 
 
 
• **Food Corporation of India (FCI)**
 
 
• Founded in - **1965**
 
• HQ - **New Delhi**
 
• It is a statutory body created and run by the Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Law Commission of India**
 
 
• Established in - **1955**
 
• HQ - **New Delhi**
 
• It is an advisory body to the Ministry of Law and Justice.
 
 
 
• **Other Constitutional Bodies in India**
 
 
• Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
 
• Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG)
 
• Finance Commission
